title: Franklin Miller Inc.
description: About Franklin Miller Inc. Franklin Miller has been engineering wastewater grinders, crushers, shredders, and screens for municipal and industrial applications since 1918. Their products are designed for reliability and efficiency, catering to industries such as wastewater treatment, food processing, mining, oil and gas, and recycling. The company is committed to providing comprehensive post-sale support, ensuring that their equipment operates at peak performance. Trusted by industry leaders worldwide, Franklin Miller's equipment is precision manufactured in the USA to handle the toughest jobs. As a result of the attack on "Franklin Miller", more than 250 GB of confidential data were stolen. The organization lost control over documents such as drawings and project documentation, confidential agreements, banking and other financial information, as well as employees’ personal data.
